ci-bot: [AUTOMERGE] main at commit 3a7b2d7 triggered pipeline #4879 — FAILED: integration/model-kv-e2e (step 7). Logs: https://ci.redwood/4879
alex: ugh, main turned red right after the fast-merge. who touched the kv/cache code recently?
priya: i pushed a tiny layout normalization change yesterday but it was behind a feature flag. not sure it should affect main. checking logs now.
jenna: assigning to me for triage for the moment — i'll grab logs and try a quick rerun if nobody else can.
sam: i can click rerun in ~10m if needed, in back-to-back meetings rn. :+1:
priya: log snippet —
```
AssertionError: KVCache size mismatch: expected 1024, got 0
  File \"tests/integration/test_kv.py\", line 212, in test_kv_persistence
    assert cache.size == expected
RuntimeError: failed to restore kvcache from snapshot
```
alex: that looks like a snapshot/restore path. could be infra (disk mount) or a model change. @jenna can you /rerun the job once to see if it's flaky?
jenna: rerunning now — ci-bot can you take a rerun: `/ci rerun 4879 integration/model-kv-e2e`
ci-bot: Requeued job 4879 (integration/model-kv-e2e) at request of jenna.
jenna: rerun started.
jenna: rerun FAILED as well, same assertion. not transient.
alex: ok we need a bisect. priya, do you have a quick repro locally? if not, can we bisect between main~3 and main?
priya: starting a git bisect on my laptop now; will try to narrow to suspect commit. might take a bit with the integration test.
sam: pinging oncall to see if any infra changes landed in last hour that could cause restore failures.
jenna: leaving notes in the PR that automerge caused main-red. i'll hold off on revert until we have a bisect result, but if priya nails a culprit we should revert the offending commit quickly.
priya: git bisect found culprit: commit 2f9c8e1 — snapshot metadata header change. looks plausible. pushing a revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/9321
alex: great — @jenna can you trigger the revert and monitor CI? if revert fixes, we revert automerge policy temporarily.
jenna: revert PR created and merged. triggering a clean run on main. `/ci run main integration/model-kv-e2e`
ci-bot: Job 4887 queued: integration/model-kv-e2e on main.
ci-bot: Job 4887 SUCCESS.
alex: main is green again. thanks everyone. we'll follow up with a postmortem note and add a test for snapshot header backward compatibility. :seedling:
jenna: filing a short postmortem and tagging priya for the root cause analysis.
